scope: Drawn areaid.sl on 81:1 is merged across reachable hierarchy. For a single connected marker, its lower-left bounding-box corner must be (0,0); disconnected markers require origin review. All merged seal geometry must meet the catalog minimum width of 6 um, including ring walls. The manual x.28 N/A is not treated as a waiver of finite error record r392. Absence is recorded separately and does not establish a complete seal or chip. No advanced-seal cell selector or diffusion-overlap exemption is inferred. Only Manhattan geometry, exact orthogonal paths and unit orthogonal hierarchy on a 1 nm grid are supported.
